flows.title: Volunteer intake and scoped conversational followup

nodes.summary: Route the actual incoming text using its sender and conversation. No test answer or consent is fabricated.

choices.label: Signup or an invited identity reply
STOP or a sensitive personal concern

nodes.title: Do we have their real name and consent?
nodes.summary: A full name plus an actual affirmative YES/Y can satisfy both. An incidental or quoted YES cannot.

choices.label: Name and explicit consent are valid
An essential name or consent fact is missing

nodes.title: Are role interests already known?
nodes.summary: Use only this church configured catalogue. Anything/ANY is flexible interest, never clearance.

choices.label: Saved role interests are complete
Role interests are missing

nodes.title: Are essential availability facts understood?
nodes.summary: Keep validated days, dates, windows and exclusions. Concise signup does not invent an unstated serving frequency.

choices.label: Sufficient valid availability is saved
A required restriction remains ambiguous

nodes.title: Ask only for the missing fact
nodes.summary: Check that the required intake question is genuinely missing and has not already been requested in this scope.

choices.label: New essential question is allowed
Question repeats a supplied fact or prior request

nodes.title: Gloo writes the targeted intake reply
nodes.summary: Give Gloo the actual reply and saved sender facts. Validate required wording and style; delivery still requires the send gate.

choices.label: Valid Gloo text passes review and delivery guards
Gloo fails or its reply is invalid

nodes.title: Wait for the person real answer
nodes.summary: A permitted question is sent only through the connected guarded path. Receiving an answer begins another intake decision.

nodes.title: Save valid preferences without inventing a booking
nodes.summary: Volunteer preferences are saved without an assignment. Current PR191 volunteer-first scheduling lets the volunteer work through a draft before final coordinator approval. Native opportunity reply is confirmed; actual live choice/final approval are not established.

nodes.title: Hold or suppress internally

nodes.end: No outgoing text and no invented signup facts.

nodes.title: Honor opt-out or route personal care
nodes.summary: STOP takes priority. Sensitive input creates a human follow-up and blocks routine messages to that sender.
nodes.end: Opt-out or care state is preserved; essential logistics are handled separately.

choices.label: Begin the hard-rule checks
